notes.zh-CN: 手机已登录界面移除 GrokX/MOBILE 顶栏，主题与语言切换移至「电脑」页右上角，应用名称和版本显示在该页底部，让对话区再增加约 65px 阅读空间。保留登录页设置入口及系统状态栏安全区，窄屏和放大字号下设置控件可换行。macOS 为通用包；Windows 安装包未签名；APK 为调试签名，沿用 0.55.1 签名；IPA 为开发签名，仅限团队注册设备。
notes.en: Removed the GrokX/MOBILE header after mobile sign-in, freeing about 65px for conversation content. Theme and language controls now live at the top right of the Computer page; the app name and version appear at its bottom. Sign-in controls and system safe-area spacing are retained, and settings wrap on narrow screens with enlarged text. macOS is universal; Windows installers are unsigned; the APK is debug-signed with the same identity as 0.55.1; the IPA is development-signed for registered team devices only.
